benchmark.title: RHEL 9 / Rocky / Alma / CentOS Stream 9 Starter

checks.title: SELinux is enforcing
checks.rationale: SELinux in permissive or disabled mode loses kernel-level mandatory access control.

checks.title: firewalld service is active
checks.rationale: firewalld provides host-based packet filtering on RHEL 9.

checks.title: chronyd time service is active
checks.rationale: Accurate time supports log correlation, certificate validity, and Kerberos.
checks.remediation: systemctl enable --now chronyd; configure /etc/chrony.conf with approved NTP peers.

checks.title: auditd service is active
checks.rationale: auditd captures kernel/syscall events for forensic and intrusion analysis.
checks.remediation: systemctl enable --now auditd; ensure /etc/audit/rules.d/ has approved rule set.

checks.title: Root SSH login is disabled
checks.rationale: Direct root SSH login is a top-tier attack vector.
checks.remediation: Set 'PermitRootLogin no' in /etc/ssh/sshd_config and reload sshd.

checks.title: SSH password authentication is disabled
checks.rationale: Key-only SSH blocks credential brute force.

checks.title: AIDE intrusion-detection package is installed
checks.rationale: AIDE tracks file-integrity baselines for change detection.

checks.title: dnf-automatic security updates configured
checks.rationale: Automatic security updates close patch windows.
checks.remediation: dnf install dnf-automatic; configure /etc/dnf/automatic.conf; systemctl enable --now dnf-automatic.timer.

checks.title: /etc/shadow has no empty password fields
checks.rationale: Accounts with empty passwords allow unauthenticated login.
checks.remediation: passwd -l <user> to lock accounts with empty passwords.

checks.title: Login banner /etc/issue.net is configured
checks.rationale: Pre-login banner provides legal notice.
checks.remediation: Populate /etc/issue.net with the organization's authorized-use banner.

checks.title: Manual: verify partition mounts (/tmp, /var, /var/log, /home) are separate
checks.audit: Run 'findmnt /tmp /var /var/log /var/log/audit /home /dev/shm' and confirm each is its own filesystem with nodev,nosuid,noexec where appropriate.
checks.rationale: Separate partitions enforce per-mount options and prevent /var fill from blocking the OS.
checks.remediation: Repartition during install or use systemd mount unit overrides.

checks.title: Manual: confirm SSH client/server crypto policy uses FUTURE or LEGACY=FALSE
checks.audit: Run 'update-crypto-policies --show' and confirm DEFAULT or FUTURE. Avoid LEGACY which re-enables MD5/3DES.
checks.rationale: System-wide crypto policy controls cipher posture for SSH/TLS clients.

checks.title: SELinux is set to enforcing in /etc/selinux/config
checks.rationale: The persisted config must be enforcing so SELinux survives reboot.

checks.title: SSH MaxAuthTries is 4 or fewer
checks.rationale: Fewer attempts per connection slows online brute force.

checks.title: SSH X11 forwarding is disabled
checks.rationale: X11 forwarding exposes the client X server to the remote host.

checks.title: SSH idle timeout (ClientAliveInterval) is configured
checks.rationale: Idle sessions should be terminated to limit hijacking.

checks.title: SSH LoginGraceTime is 60 seconds or less
checks.rationale: A short grace time limits unauthenticated connection windows.

checks.title: SSH warning banner is configured
checks.rationale: A pre-auth banner provides legal notice.

checks.title: rsyslog service is active
checks.rationale: Centralized syslog underpins monitoring and incident response.

checks.title: IP forwarding is disabled
checks.rationale: A non-router host should not forward packets.

checks.title: ICMP redirects are not accepted
checks.rationale: Accepting ICMP redirects allows route-table tampering.

checks.title: Source-routed packets are not accepted
checks.rationale: Source routing can bypass network controls.

checks.title: TCP SYN cookies are enabled
checks.rationale: SYN cookies mitigate SYN-flood denial of service.

checks.title: ASLR is enabled
checks.rationale: Full ASLR makes memory-corruption exploits harder.

checks.title: Core dumps from setuid programs are restricted
checks.rationale: setuid core dumps can leak sensitive memory contents.

checks.title: Password maximum age is 365 days or fewer
checks.rationale: Bounding password age limits the lifetime of a leaked credential.
checks.remediation: Set PASS_MAX_DAYS to 365 or fewer in /etc/login.defs.

checks.title: Password minimum length is 14 or more
checks.rationale: Longer minimum length increases brute-force resistance.
